rule: A second Crossref record or second DOI of an article already counted.
Editorials, errata, book reviews, comments and replies, issue information, summaries of unpublished work.

category: Management Science outside the covered departments
rule: From 2003 on, only papers accepted by the strategy, entrepreneurship and innovation (and its predecessor) or organizations departments are covered.

category: No separately stated hypothesis tested in the paper (screen before extraction)
rule: The paper states no hypothesis set off from the running text and tested on its own data: theory papers, formal models, essays, qualitative and descriptive studies, and empirical papers whose predictions stay in running text.

category: No counted statement after statement-level review
rule: After extraction, no statement of the paper meets the set-off rule: predictions only in running text, propositions the paper does not test, corollaries.

category: Hypotheses only in a table, or not tested statement by statement
rule: Hypotheses given only as a list inside a table, or propositions assessed only by exploratory comparison, case narrative or qualitative material rather than a quantitative test of each statement.
Hypotheses tested on effect sizes of other studies, not on the paper's own data.

category: Not strategy or organization research (topic screen before extraction)
rule: The core question, unit and outcome are not about organizations as strategic actors or their structure and environment.
Question, mechanism and outcome stay at the level of individuals or teams inside organizations (organizational behavior).

category: Individual decision makers without an organization-level outcome
rule: Individual-level rule: individual decision makers, investors or consumers studied without a firm-level outcome.
Finance, accounting, operations, marketing, information systems, economics or public policy questions that are not about organization strategy or structure.
